passives: Hierarchy of Living Edict: Malachor Law Warden gains Choir Resonance when its breaker choices express Radiant Hierarchies source-culture law through edict-sung holy geometry; Earth myth is only the later echo.
lore: Malachor Law Warden is a colossal Empyrean breaker from The Radiant Hierarchies. Humans later copied fragments of this being into myth, ritual, monster lore, and sacred art, but the Deity is the older source: Empyrean breaker office: judgement rupture, armor sundering, trial by force; Seraphim: burning praise, purification flame, six-wing intensity.
personality: Ancient, immense, purposeful, and bound to the survival philosophy of its Realm.
visualDescription: Full-body living myth-source deity, not a costume: Malachor Law Warden shows white-gold radiance, many-eye auras, glass armor, feathered and non-feathered wing geometries, bell-metal joints, choral vibration lines, living scroll seals, stair-ladders of light, cathedral vault anatomy, ophanim wheels, seraph fire, cherub guardian masks.. Role silhouette must read as Breaker. Materials include white gold, opal glass, bell bronze, pearl bone, blue-white holy fire, ivory scroll vellum, silver feather. The design must feel older than human mythology and avoid robot angel, spaceship armor, generic church costume, literal cathedral body, block tower silhouette, neon sci-fi aura.
developmentStatus: Combat kit, source-culture weapons, gear, abilities, leveling hooks, and balance pass complete; artwork pending.

abilityDetails.name: Malachor Law Warden — Seraph Edict Lash Rend
abilityDetails.effect: Deal Empyrean source-culture damage at range 2; generate Momentum and a small Choir Resonance gain when used from edict-sung holy geometry or against the marked target. The hit reads visually as white-gold radiance, many-eye auras, opal glass, bell bronze, wing geometries, scroll seals, ophanim wheels, seraph fire.
abilityDetails.scaling: 100% attack; +15% when the target is vulnerable or standing in faction-favored terrain
abilityDetails.counterplay: Break line of sight, deny favored terrain, bait the mark, or force the Deity into low-value targets.

abilityDetails.name: Choir Seal Technique — Rupture
abilityDetails.effect: Spend Momentum to breaks guard, exposes vulnerability, and punishes armor or shield reliance. Builds Choir Resonance only when the player uses edict-sung holy geometry intelligently; never a generic buff button.
abilityDetails.scaling: 70% attack plus role utility scaling from energy and mastery tier
abilityDetails.counterplay: Interrupt before resolution, spread enemy ranks, deny the setup terrain, or bait the cooldown.

abilityDetails.name: Malachor Law Warden: Ophanim Throne Judgment Sundering Trial
abilityDetails.effect: Spend stored Choir Resonance to impose a two-round rule from Radiant Hierarchies: breaks guard, exposes vulnerability, and punishes armor or shield reliance. Enemies receive a readable counter-window before the strongest effect lands.
abilityDetails.scaling: 140% attack where damage applies; utility duration +1 at mastery tier 4
abilityDetails.counterplay: Move out of the rule zone, drain Momentum/Divinity, stagger the Deity, or exploit the exposed recovery turn.

abilityDetails.name: Divine Ascension — Seraphic Choir Unbound
abilityDetails.effect: Enter Ascendant stance for 2 rounds: amplify Choir Resonance, transform nearby terrain into edict-sung holy geometry, empower one Signature, and reveal the Realm as the original source behind human myth. Ends with a one-round recovery risk.
abilityDetails.scaling: Does not stack with external ultimate buffs
abilityDetails.counterplay: Survive the window, disengage from transformed terrain, deny objectives during recovery, or force defensive reaction spending.

equipmentDetails.name: Malachor Law Warden Sunderer Seraph Bell-Edict Blade
equipmentDetails.effect: +3 attack. Basic attacks gain +4 Momentum once per round when they express source-culture canon through edict-sung holy geometry. Visual: white-gold radiance, many-eye auras, opal glass, bell bronze, wing geometries, scroll seals, ophanim wheels, seraph fire.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: No extra action loops; empowered basics are once per round.

equipmentDetails.name: Malachor Law Warden Opal-Glass Cherubim Aegis
equipmentDetails.effect: Improves survivability and makes the Deity read as Radiant Hierarchies source-culture gear, not costume armor. Reduces first terrain/hazard punishment each encounter if the player followed the faction mechanic.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Mitigation cannot stack past role caps; does not erase telegraphed boss danger.

equipmentDetails.name: Malachor Law Warden Ophanim Many-Eye Choir Core
equipmentDetails.effect: Stores Choir Resonance and unlocks a mastery branch for Archangel Herald Ascent, Ophanim Wheel Intercept, and Seal the Discord. Rewards correct terrain and reaction play rather than passive stat gain.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Resource refund has a per-round cap and cannot chain Ascension windows.

leveling.powerFormula: hp + attack*6 + range*5 + energy*7 + speed*6 + armor*2 + resistance*2 + critChance

balanceNotes.intendedDifficulty: Tuned for harder solo encounters: every deity can win alone, but mistakes against counters starve Momentum/Divinity.
balanceNotes.primaryRole: break armor, shields, and boss windows
